newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU consumer confidence up in first rise since March.
newsitem.headline: EU consumer confidence up in first rise since March.

text.p: European consumers showed a surprising burst of confidence in October after unemployment in the European Union remained unchanged in September for the fourth consecuitve month, separate reports said Tuesday.
"Consumer confidence has gone up for the first time since March, reinforcing the improvement of the overall economic climate," the European Commission, the EU's executive body, said.
At the same time Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said in another report that unemployment in the EU remained at 10.8 percent in September for the fourth consecutive month.

In its monthly survey of consumers and businesses, the European Commission said its economic sentiment indicator, which combines the views of industry, the construction sector and consumers, showed an increase in all of the EU's 15 nations except Italy.
